_comment: Nightly ability-usage gate bands (tools/ci/ability-usage-gates.ts). Calibrated to `pnpm ability:usage --seeds 8` (Arcade, AI level 3, all 66 pairings; the run is deterministic). maxTopShare = the hero's largest per-slot cast share measured, plus about 0.03 of headroom. A slot under deadBelowCastsPerMinute is dead. Move a band only on purpose, with the ability:usage numbers in the commit.
